title: Everyday acting
description: The glue between everything else: walking at his own pace, sitting down and getting up, turning, and the small things he does when nothing is happening. Front-facing clips start and end in the canonical standing pose so they can follow each other.

clips.action: Yoru walks to the left upright on his hind legs at an unhurried, self-possessed pace: not running, not bouncing. Seen exactly from the side, facing left. A full walk cycle that loops: each foot plants and pushes off, the capelet and tail sway a beat behind the body. His head stays level and his expression is calm and slightly unimpressed.
beats: Left foot forward and planted, right foot pushing off behind.
Right foot lifting and passing, body at its highest.
Right foot reaching forward, capelet swinging back.
Right foot planted forward, left foot pushing off behind.
Left foot lifting and passing, body at its highest.
Left foot reaching forward, capelet swinging back.
Left foot planted again, tail swaying the other way.
Weight settling onto the left foot, ready to repeat.

clips.action: Yoru walks to the right upright on his hind legs at an unhurried, self-possessed pace: not running, not bouncing. Seen exactly from the side, facing right. Draw him facing right; do not simply mirror a left-facing drawing, his forelock stays on the same side of his own face. A full walk cycle that loops: each foot plants and pushes off, the capelet and tail sway a beat behind the body. His head stays level and his expression is calm and slightly unimpressed.
beats: Right foot forward and planted, left foot pushing off behind.
Left foot lifting and passing, body at its highest.
Left foot reaching forward, capelet swinging back.
Left foot planted forward, right foot pushing off behind.
Right foot lifting and passing, body at its highest.
Right foot reaching forward, capelet swinging back.
Right foot planted again, tail swaying the other way.
Weight settling onto the right foot, ready to repeat.

clips.action: Yoru turns from facing the viewer, as in the identity reference, to facing left in profile, ready to walk. Head first, then shoulders, then body and feet; tail and capelet follow last.
beats: Standing facing the viewer exactly as in the identity reference.
Head turned to look left, body still facing the viewer.
Shoulders and capelet turning left, one foot stepping round.
Body three-quarters to the left, tail swinging behind.
In profile facing left, standing, ready to walk.

clips.action: Yoru sits down facing the viewer, deliberately and without hurry. His body lowers onto his haunches, front paws come to rest in front of him, the tail curls round his feet and the capelet settles.
beats: Standing facing the viewer exactly as in the identity reference.
Knees bending, body starting to lower, tail swinging forward.
Halfway down, front paws coming forward.
Haunches touching the ground, front paws on the ground in front.
Seated upright, tail curling round his feet, capelet settling.
Seated and still, half-lidded, a little smug.

clips.action: Yoru sits facing the viewer, resting and self-possessed. A quiet loop: slow breathing, one slow blink, one small flick of the tail tip. Same pose and size in every frame.
beats: Seated, eyes half-lidded.
Eyes closing in a slow blink.
Eyes closed.
Eyes half-lidded again, chest slightly raised with a breath.
Tail tip flicking slightly.
Seated, settled, as in the first frame.

clips.action: Yoru gets up from sitting facing the viewer and ends standing exactly as in the identity reference. Not the sit-down played backwards: he leans forward first, pushes up with his legs, and the capelet falls back into place last.
beats: Seated facing the viewer, half-lidded.
Leaning forward slightly, weight shifting onto his feet.
Pushing up, haunches lifting off the ground.
Rising, body upright, tail swinging back behind.
Nearly standing, capelet still settling.
Standing facing the viewer exactly as in the identity reference.

clips.action: Yoru, standing facing the viewer, yawns: a real, wide, slightly undignified yawn with his eyes squeezed shut and ears flattening back, then recovers his composure as if nothing happened.
beats: Standing facing the viewer exactly as in the identity reference.
Eyes closing, mouth starting to open, head tilting back slightly.
Mouth opening wide, ears flattening back, small fangs showing.
Widest point of the yawn, eyes squeezed shut, body stretching up a little.
Mouth closing, ears coming back up, a sleepy blink.
Composed again, half-lidded, as if nothing happened.

clips.action: Yoru, sitting facing the viewer, grooms himself: he licks one front paw and wipes it over his face and ear, once, then puts the paw down and returns to sitting as if he had not been doing anything at all.
beats: Seated facing the viewer, half-lidded.
Lifting one front paw towards his mouth.
Licking the paw, eyes closed.
Wiping the paw over his cheek and eye.
Wiping the paw up over his ear, ear folding under it.
Paw coming down, ear springing back up.
Paw back on the ground, a quick look to the side.
Seated facing the viewer again, half-lidded, composed.
